entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Use a canonical project for file-based apps which lack `#:` directives #81099
  • Verify AsyncHelpers.HandleAsyncEntryPoint test execution #81097
    .NET 11

Closed

  • Compiler doesn't report an error for dynamic evaluation of `&&`/`||` when left operand is statically typed as an interface with `true`/`false` operator. #80954
    18.3
  • Update async `Main` code generation #80873
    .NET 11
  • Live file-based program directive diagnostics #80006
    Next
  • OpenProjectAsync timeouting on 5.0 version of CodeAnalysis API #80113
    18.0
  • Assembly references used by anonymous types are not added to the set of used assembly references. #73558
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-11206.224 #81096
  • Hiccup causes "Computing Rename Information" tooltip to be stuck #80679
  • C# VS2022 Bug when trying to rename variables in local static functions. #60728
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11206.22 #81091

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/dev17.11] Add monthly smoke test to release branch official builds #81098

Merged

  • Report an error for dynamic evaluation of `&&`/`||` when left operand is statically typed as an interface #80962
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add support for HandleAsyncEntryPoint API in async Main code generation #80939
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • File-based programs live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Record anonymous type dependencies during initial binding #81024
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Add order attribute to PeekableItemSourceProvider #81095
    Area-IDE, Community, Next
  • Add feature status for closed class hierarchies #81040
    Area-Compilers, Documentation, Next
  • Use standard overload resolution for `true`/`false` operators while binding applications of dynamic `&&`/`||` operators #81055
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix rename conflict detection for local functions and lambdas #80821
    VSCode, Next
  • Fixes Stack Trace Explorer color contrast ratio #81093
    Area-IDE, Needs UX Triage, Next
  • Expose a few constants to Razor #81094
    Area-IDE, Next

Updated

  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81058
    Area-Compilers, Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Remove parameters which are redundant with _localScopeDepth #81045
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix list patterns on pointer types causing internal compiler error #81059
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve error message for record inheritance without parameter list #80795
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix superfluous managed address errors for pointer to non-existent type #80760
    Area-Compilers
  • Include default RSP files for core compilers #80993
    Area-Compilers
  • Make RuntimeHostInfoTests more robust #81080
    Area-Compilers
  • Target typed conditional expression recovery #81025
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Fix returning valid pp symbol info on unrelated preprocessor directives #72910
    Area-Compilers, Community, untriaged, Backlog
  • Avoid premature full binding of a receiver as a value in the process of binding possible type-or-value receiver (so-called “Color Color” scenario) #80978
    Area-Compilers
  • Unskip tests of MSBuildWorkspace with blazor and blazorwasm templates #80468
    Area-IDE, VSCode
